Interface Network

All Known Implementing Classes:
client_RMI, clientSocket
public interface Network
Generic interface for network management; both the RMI client and the socket client must implement this interface so that the ClientController can invoke network methods without knowing which network implementation is being used

    • placeTotem

      boolean placeTotem(String nickname, char position)
      Method that allows the client to place the totem on the OfferTile
      Parameters:
      nickname - name of the player performing the action
      position - position selected on the OfferTile
      Returns:
      true if the action was performed successfully; otherwise, false

    • takeCard

      boolean takeCard(String nickname, int position, boolean isUpper)
      Method that allows the player to draw a card from the upper or lower row
      Parameters:
      nickname - name of the player performing the action
      position - position indicating the selected card
      isUpper - if true, the card must be taken from the upper row; otherwise, from the lower row
      Returns:
      true if the action was performed successfully; otherwise, false

    • skipExtraDraw

      boolean skipExtraDraw(String nickname)
      Method that allows the client not to draw the extra card at the end of the turn if they possess the triggering building
      Parameters:
      nickname - name of the player performing the action
      Returns:
      true if the client has chosen not to draw the extra card due to the effect of the triggering building; otherwise, false

    • getLobby

      String getLobby(String nickname, ClientController controller)
      This method retrieves the list of available game sessions and updates the local lobby view. It also returns the identifier of the VirtualView associated with the current ClientController, which is later used by the server to move the client from the lobby context to a game context when a game is created or joined.
      Parameters:
      nickname - the nickname of the requesting player
      controller - the client controller handling the received data
      Returns:
      the VirtualView identifier associated with the client

    • createNewGame

      boolean createNewGame(String nickname, int expectedNumPlayers, Color color, String viewId)
      Creates a new game session in the server lobby. The player becomes the host of the new game and defines both the expected number of participants and the color of their own totem, which is assigned at the start of the game.
      Parameters:
      nickname - the name of the player creating the game
      expectedNumPlayers - the number of players required for the game
      color - the color chosen by the player
      viewId - the identifier of the client view connection
      Returns:
      true if the game was successfully created; otherwise false

    • joinGame

      boolean joinGame(String nickname, int id, Color color, String viewId)
      Joins an existing game session in the lobby. The player is added to the specified game if it exists and has available slots.
      Parameters:
      nickname - the name of the player joining the game
      id - the identifier of the game to join
      color - the color selected by the player
      viewId - the identifier of the client view connection
      Returns:
      true if the player successfully joined the game; otherwise false
